note: Machine-checkable transcription of the System Logic Specification.
The spec itself was supplied as a chat prompt and exists nowhere else, so
THIS FILE IS ITS DURABLE FORM. Treat it as source material, not as generated
output: do not delete a clause because it is inconvenient, and do not mark one
kind=invariant|behaviour  -> needs BOTH impl and test to count as covered
`impl` and `test` are repo-relative paths, optionally with :line. `npm run audit`
verifies every referenced path exists and reports the completion percentage.
Update this file in the same commit as the code that satisfies a clause.

clauses.rule: Visitor may browse everything public but cannot book without phone verification
Organizer is a User with an approved OrganizerProfile
Scanner Staff is a User with scan-only permission scoped per event and gate
Sub-Admin holds a permission subset: APPROVALS / FINANCE / SUPPORT / CONTENT
Every system action writes an AuditLog row with actor = SYSTEM
tickets_sold + tickets_held <= tickets_total per tier, under any concurrency
A ticket transitions to SCANNED at most once, ever
sum(LedgerEntries per booking) = 0 after the full lifecycle
Client-submitted prices are never trusted; the server recomputes everything
No state transition happens outside the defined state machines
Every Admin or Organizer mutation writes an AuditLog row with before/after JSON
Timestamps stored UTC; all business logic evaluated in Asia/Kolkata
BOOKING_HOLD_MINUTES = 8, admin-editable
PLATFORM_COMMISSION_PCT = 8 with per-organizer override
Booking fee 3.5% of subtotal, min Rs15, max Rs99 per booking, charged to the user
GST 18% on the booking fee and on the platform commission invoice
PAYOUT_DELAY_DAYS = 3 after the last session of an event
Basic Rs4,999/yr capped at 5 live events; Pro Rs14,999/yr unlimited + featured eligibility
OTP 6 digits, 5 min validity, max 3 sends/10min/phone, max 5 verify attempts then a 30-min lock
Refund policies NO_REFUND / FLEXIBLE_72H / CUSTOM ordered tiers
Reviews open 14 days after event end, only to users whose ticket status is SCANNED
Referrer gets Rs100 wallet credit when referee completes a first CONFIRMED booking >= Rs499; referee gets Rs50 off
Wallet usable up to 100% of an order, non-withdrawable; wallet refunds instant, source refunds follow gateway timelines
Event: DRAFT -> IN_REVIEW -> LIVE -> COMPLETED, with REJECTED, PAUSED and CANCELLED branches
Event auto-COMPLETED when now > last session end + 6h; triggers the settlement countdown
PAUSED hides the event from listings; existing tickets stay valid; no new sales
Event CANCELLED triggers the bulk refund process automatically and is irreversible
On LIVE, these edits need no re-review: description, gallery, FAQ, adding tiers, increasing quantity, extending sale window, price DECREASE
Date/time/venue change or price INCREASE flips the event to IN_REVIEW but it STAYS BOOKABLE at the old values until approved
On approval of a date/venue change: mandatory blast to booked users + a 72h free-cancellation window regardless of refund policy
Booking: PENDING_PAYMENT -> CONFIRMED -> cancelled variants -> REFUNDED; plus EXPIRED and FAILED
A NO_REFUND cancellation ends at CANCELLED_BY_USER and never reaches REFUNDED
Ticket: ACTIVE -> SCANNED (terminal) | CANCELLED | EXPIRED | TRANSFERRED->ACTIVE with a new qrTokenId
Payment transitions are driven by webhooks; UI callbacks are advisory only
OrganizerProfile: SIGNUP -> DETAILS_SUBMITTED -> FEE_PAID -> KYC_IN_REVIEW -> VERIFIED | KYC_REJECTED
SUSPENDED auto-PAUSES all LIVE events, FREEZES payouts, and leaves login read-only
Payout: ACCRUING -> SCHEDULED -> PROCESSING -> PAID | FAILED; any state -> FROZEN on dispute and back on resolution
Phone entry validated as a 10-digit Indian mobile
OTP hashed with expiry in Redis, sent via the SMS provider, rate limits applied
On verify: find-or-create User, issue an httpOnly JWT session with 30-day rolling expiry
Failure paths: wrong OTP shows remaining attempts, expired offers resend, locked shows a cooldown
Google/email auth still requires phone verification before the first booking
First visit IP-geo guesses the city and offers a confirm/change banner; the choice persists
All marketplace queries filter by cityId; changing city rewrites the URL prefix and clears locality filters
Near Me uses browser geolocation stored in session only, never the database; denial falls back to the locality picker
Listing composes from URL params; every filter change updates the URL without a reload and preserves scroll
Availability chips: >=0.9 Few Left, >=0.7 Filling Fast, all sold or window over Sold Out, event today Today
Trending = 0.6*normalized(sales_72h) + 0.4*normalized(views_72h), recomputed hourly; views deduped per user/IP per hour
Multi-session events default to the nearest upcoming session; sold-out sessions greyed; Season Pass bypasses the session picker
Select step shows a live estimate that is explicitly not authoritative
Validate event LIVE, session future, tier active and in its sale window, and qty <= perUserLimit minus the user's prior confirmed qty for that tier
Atomic per-tier hold; if any tier's guarded UPDATE touches 0 rows the whole transaction rolls back and per-tier availability is returned
Create Booking PENDING_PAYMENT with expiresAt = now + hold minutes, schedule the release job, return a server countdown timestamp
Attendee name per ticket, editable until payment; buyer phone and email captured
Promo validated on window, minAmount, usageLimit and perUserLimit; discount computed server-side; usedCount incremented only at capture
Wallet applies min(balance, total); covering 100% skips the gateway entirely with method WALLET
Gateway order created in paise with the booking number as receipt; UPI intent offered first
payment.captured is idempotent by gateway event id and performs capture in one transaction
payment.failed releases holds immediately and offers retry as a NEW booking attempt
Capture arriving after hold expiry re-acquires inventory atomically, or auto-refunds in full and leaves the booking EXPIRED
Confirmation shows QR tickets, a calendar file, share and an invite nudge
Reconciliation every 10 min settles Payments in CREATED older than 15 min against the gateway
Transfer allowed only on ACTIVE tickets, when the event permits it, and more than 2h before the session
On acceptance the old qrTokenId is invalidated, a new one issued, ownership reassigned, and a TransferRecord written; one transfer per ticket
Cancellation previews the refundable percentage, the mode choice, and the non-refundable breakdown before confirming
On cancel: tickets CANCELLED, inventory restored ONLY if more than 6h before the session, Refund row created, ledger reversed
Refund webhook completes the Refund; failure retries three times then escalates to the FINANCE queue
T-24h and T-2h reminders with gate time, venue map link and a QR deep link
Ticket QR is cached client-side after first load so it works without network at the venue
Season pass scanning writes a SessionScan child row unique on (ticketId, sessionId); status flips to SCANNED only after the final session
Nightly job marks unscanned ACTIVE tickets of ended sessions EXPIRED and completes events
Review invite at T+18h to SCANNED attendees; organizer may reply once; admin may hide with an audited reason; organizer rating recomputed on publish
Capture writes TICKET_SALE, COMMISSION, GST_COMMISSION, BOOKING_FEE and GST_BOOKING_FEE rows; the worked example nets organizer Rs815.04 and platform Rs126.26
Ledger rows are persisted to the database at capture, not merely computed
Full refund mirror-reverses every row and returns the booking fee only on organizer/admin fault; a partial refund reverses only the sale and commission rows
Daily 02:00 IST payout run selects COMPLETED events past the payout delay, excluding suspended organizers and events with an open dispute
Payouts are FINANCE-approved in batches, or auto-approved under the configured ceiling, then PAID with a ledger debit and a generated GST invoice
A negative balance carries forward to the next event; 60 days inactive with a negative balance goes to the FINANCE collection queue
Plan checkout on capture records onboardingFeePaidAt, stores the plan, writes an ONBOARDING_FEE ledger row and unlocks KYC
Renewal reminders at T-30/7/1; a lapsed plan blocks creating or publishing new events but leaves LIVE events unaffected
Onboarding gates run in order and cannot be skipped: details, fee, KYC docs (PAN mandatory), bank proof, admin review
KYC review SLA is 48h; overdue items are highlighted in the admin queue
Event wizard autosaves DRAFT per step; final submit validates >=1 future session, >=1 tier, sale windows within the session start, cover image, geocoded venue, refund policy and T&C
Admin review shows a rendered preview, raw fields and organizer history; rejection carries a reason; resubmission shows a diff
Admin-toggleable auto-approval for VERIFIED organizers with >=3 past events, rating >=4.2 and zero disputes, flagged for post-hoc check
Dashboard numbers are 60s cached aggregates, switching to 10s polling on event day
Quantity increase and price decrease apply instantly; a price increase requires re-review
Announcement blasts are queued and throttled to 10/s, capped at 3 per event per week; cancellation and reschedule templates bypass the cap
Staff pick from today's assigned events only, then a gate; the session is selected automatically by time
Live ops board shows entered vs expected overall, per gate and per tier, with a scan-rate sparkline
More than 5 INVALID scans per minute at one gate alerts the organizer and admin as possible fraud
Organizer can mark Gates Closed; the scanner then rejects with GATES_CLOSED, overridable only by the organizer-owner login
Scan checks run in order, first failure wins: NOT_AUTHORIZED, WRONG_SESSION, GATES_CLOSED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, season-pass path, then the atomic claim
The claim is an atomic guarded UPDATE; zero rows affected means ALREADY_SCANNED, returned with the time, gate and staff name
A ScanLog row is written for every attempt including failures; the result flash auto-dismisses after 2s
At gate-open minus 30 min the device downloads an encrypted event-scoped manifest, delta-synced every 60s while online
Offline claims validate against the manifest and queue in IndexedDB with a device timestamp; same-device duplicates are caught, cross-gate duplicates explicitly are not
On reconnect the queue replays in device-timestamp order; conflicts return a reconciliation summary and raise a ScanConflict for organizer review
Dispute: OPEN -> INVESTIGATING -> RESOLVED_REFUND | RESOLVED_REJECT | RESOLVED_PARTIAL
Opening a dispute on an event auto-freezes that event's payout portion
Resolution actions execute atomically with the resolution record; user and organizer are both notified with the outcome note
Category, festival, city and locality edits deactivate and never delete, because events reference them
Banners are city-scoped with start/end datetimes and sort order; curation lists are ordered event ids validated LIVE-only at render
A commission change applies only to bookings after the change timestamp; ledger rows store the pct used
Sub-admin permissions are enforced server-side per route; every grant and revoke is audited
SUPPORT may credit a wallet up to Rs500; anything larger needs FINANCE
hold-release: per-booking delayed job releasing expired holds, with a 1-minute Redis TTL backstop sweep
payment-reconcile: every 10 minutes, settle stale CREATED payments
reminders: hourly, T-24h and T-2h event reminders
ticket-expiry: 03:00 IST, ACTIVE to EXPIRED for ended sessions and events to COMPLETED
trending-recompute: hourly trending scores
payout-run: 02:00 IST daily settlement
review-invites: 04:00 IST
refund-retry: every 30 minutes, retry failed gateway refunds three times then escalate
kyc/plan reminders: daily SLA nudges and renewal notices
manifest-refresh: every minute on event day, the scanner delta-sync source
digest: Monday 09:00, organizer weekly and admin platform digests
Two users race for the last ticket: exactly one CONFIRMED
The same QR scanned simultaneously at two gates online: exactly one VALID
Webhook delivered twice or out of order: idempotent by gateway event id, CAPTURED is terminal over FAILED
User closes the tab mid-payment but pays in the UPI app anyway: the late-capture path completes the booking
Hold expires while the user is on the gateway page: re-acquire, or refund in full
Organizer cancels an event with 4,000 bookings: batched refunds of 500, progress visible to admin, one blast sent
Promo race at the usage limit: consumption is reserved at order creation like inventory and released on failure or expiry
A midnight-spanning session belongs to its start date and the scanner accepts until session end, not until the date changes
Ticket transferred after a reminder was sent: the recipient gets a fresh message and the old QR reads INVALID
Wallet-only booking: no gateway order, capture runs synchronously inside the booking transaction
Organizer suspended mid-event-day: scanning continues, payouts freeze, new sales stop
Refund requested at the 72h boundary plus or minus a minute: policy evaluated at the submission timestamp, server-side, in IST
Account deletion with future ACTIVE tickets is blocked; allowed after cancel or transfer; soft-delete retains ledger and audit
Duplicate signup via Google and phone merges into the existing account behind an explicit consent screen
A locality with zero events shows a festive empty state with nearby suggestions, never a dead page
